subject: test(ssh_dotnet): add Dispose + CreateAdapter unit tests (no fakes)
body:
test(ssh_dotnet): add Dispose + CreateAdapter unit tests (no fakes)

- ProtocolSshDotNet.Dispose: no-throw when never connected + idempotent
  (validates the canonical IDisposable / ProtocolBase.Dispose fix, 4a).
- SshConnectionManager.CreateAdapter: returns a non-null unconnected adapter and
  validates its arguments (validates the ISshClientAdapter seam factory, 4b).

All exercise real objects -- no test doubles, no SSH server required.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Tests target fork-specific SSH.NET protocol (ProtocolSshDotNet/SshConnectionManager) absent from our fork; we use PuTTY. Nothing to test here.
